Per the Queensland Government page (https://www.business.qld.gov.au/industries/building-property-development/building-construction/laws-codes-standards/queensland-development-code) it is superseded by the Queensland Housing Code (QHC; listed 14 August 2026, commenced 1 September 2026). The QHC applies in a local government area only once the planning scheme is amended to say how it applies, or from 1 September 2029; until then the 2010 QDC parts continue.
